title: After every workout, the new-badge line re-reads the member's whole lifting history
what: When a workout is finished, the badge line on the Workout complete screen works out every badge again from scratch: every workout ever saved, every heavy set ever logged, the whole body weight list and all records. The saved copy is thrown away because the history just changed, so this happens on every finish. It does not hold up the screen, but on a long history the badge line can appear late on a slow phone, and the five-years-of-data speed check never times it.
expected: Only the badges this workout could have earned are checked, or the badge read is at least timed in the five-years speed check with a limit.
fix_line: Add the badge read to the five-years speed check; if it is slow, check only what the new workout adds

items.reason: this area is phone app logic; it holds no admin-panel pages, so web page load scores do not apply
the phone holds one member's own data, no gym member lists; the long lists here (History) are paged a page at a time with a row limit
